name: Comment
description: Represents a comment on a given slide or slide range. The Comment object is a member of the Comments collection object.
remarks: Use the following properties to access comment data:
example:
Sub ShowComment()

    With ActivePresentation.Slides(1).Comments

        If .Count > 0 Then

            MsgBox "The first comment on this slide is by " & .Item(1).Author

        Else

            MsgBox "There are no comments on this slide."

        End If

    End With

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: Author
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the author as for a specified Comment object. Read-only.

properties.name: AuthorInitials
properties.description: Returns the author's initials as a read-only String for a specified Comment object. Read-only.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the text in a comment. Read-only.

properties.name: DateTime
properties.description: Returns the date and time a comment was created.

properties.name: AuthorIndex
properties.description: Returns a Long representing the index number of a comment for a given author. The first comment for a given author has an index number of 1, their second comment has an index number of 2. Read-only.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns a Single that represents the distance in points from the left edge of the comment to the left edge of the slide. Read-only.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns a Single that represents the distance in points from the left edge of the comment to the left edge of the slide. Read-only.

properties.name: ProviderID
properties.description: Returns a String that represents ID of the service providing contact information. Read-only.

properties.name: UserID
properties.description: Returns a String that represents user ID of the contact. Read-only.

properties.name: TimeZoneBias
properties.description: Returns a String that specifies the local time zone adjustment for the contact. Read-only.

properties.name: Replies
properties.description: Returns a Comments collection of Comment objects that are children of the specified comment. Read-only.

properties.name: Collapsed
properties.description: Returns whether the replies to a comment are shown (expanded) or hidden (collapsed). Ready-only.
